opening.argument: The speaker identifies the subject as money-making methods in GTA 5 Online, then walks through activities within that game: accessing contract missions through an auto shop, completing a weekly time trial, and entering races that award money and RP. The contract board is visible in gameplay. These are instructions for earning virtual rewards through game objectives, not an offer of real-world income. Even the rapid-wealth language and reported payouts are tied to those in-game activities. Requests to like or subscribe are ordinary channel engagement; they are not presented as a condition for receiving money or as part of a financial offer.
